text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: On one planted 29% step, most estimators followed the loss within days, and S0 and EM never did'
text.tspan: Figure 2: On one planted 29% step, most estimators followed the loss
within days, and S0 and EM never did

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One planted loss, the same in every panel: a step that cuts one plant's power by 29% for 30 days, starting on day 0. Each panel draws the capacity an estimator reports for the plant with the loss, divided by what it reports without the loss. A forecast for day T reads whole days up to day T−2. Before day 0 both runs read the same power, so the ratio is exactly 1. The convex programmes are solved only from the step on, so their lines start there.'
